capabilities.title: Fan-out username search across 700+ sites from WhatsMyName manifest
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Pinned 30 high-signal sites instead of the full 700+ manifest to keep scans bounded and server-side costs predictable. Detection logic (status_code + message modes) mirrors WhatsMyName conventions.

capabilities.title: Fan-out email search across breach and social sites
capabilities.reason: Email lookups are already covered by emailrep.io and HIBP integrations in ReconLookup. A separate email-fan-out adds OSINT overlap without new signal for the current feature set.

capabilities.title: AI-powered profile enrichment and cross-site correlation
capabilities.reason: AI enrichment requires paid inference at query time. Nexus is free/local; all OSINT checks use only free public endpoints. AI analysis can be initiated manually via the HQ agent on found results.

capabilities.title: Python 3 CLI and pip install flow
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a TypeScript/Next.js product. Vendoring a Python runtime for a scan sub-feature adds a heavyweight dependency. The scan logic is re-implemented in TypeScript without vendoring any Blackbird source code.

capabilities.title: Local HTML/PDF report export for scan results
capabilities.reason: Nexus VAULT tab already provides artifact export. Username scan results are display-only in the RECON panel; promoting them to persistent reports is a separate feature outside this assimilation scope.

capabilities.title: Bounded concurrent HTTP requests with timeout per site
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Max concurrency 5, per-site timeout 8 s, total guard 30 s. Concurrency pool implemented in TypeScript without the asyncio/semaphore pattern from the Python source.

capabilities.title: status_code and message-based detection types from WhatsMyName spec
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Implements the two WhatsMyName detection modes: HTTP status comparison and response body string matching. URI template uses {account} placeholder per WhatsMyName convention.
